About Carrier 
 Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.
 
 The AI Security Engineer is responsible for building, deploying, integrating, automating, and supporting security controls that protect Carrier's artificial intelligence ecosystem. This role works closely with Security Architecture, Cloud Security, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, and Application Development teams to implement secure AI solutions, operationalize AI security controls, and embed security into enterprise AI platforms and services.

 The successful candidate will possess strong technical skills in cybersecurity, cloud security, automation, identity, data protection, and AI technologies. This individual will engineer and support security capabilities that enable the secure adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI services, large language model (LLM) platforms, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI technologies.
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, build, deploy, configure, and maintain security controls supporting enterprise AI platforms and services
 Implement technical safeguards for Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, LLM applications, machine learning platforms, and AI-enabled business solutions
 Integrate AI security controls with identity management, data loss prevention, logging, monitoring, cloud access security broker, security service edge, security information and event management, and cloud security platforms
 Develop and maintain AI security automation, workflows, detections, dashboards, reporting, and operational processes
 Build and support monitoring capabilities to detect AI misuse, prompt injection attacks, unauthorized access, sensitive data exposure, and other AI security threats
 Engineer secure implementation patterns for AI application development, model deployment, API integrations, and data ingestion pipelines
 Partner with development and platform teams to implement security requirements throughout the AI lifecycle
 Develop scripts, automations, APIs, and integrations to improve AI security operations and control effectiveness
 Perform technical validation, testing, troubleshooting, tuning, and continuous improvement of AI security controls
 Support incident response, investigations, and remediation activities involving AI technologies and AI-enabled applications
 Deploy and maintain security tooling that supports AI monitoring, data protection, governance, and compliance requirements
 Develop technical documentation, implementation guides, standard operating procedures, and operational runbooks
 Provide advanced engineering support for AI-related cybersecurity issues and service requests
  
 Basic Qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or any other technical discipline; or High school diploma or GED with 4 years of military experience or 1 year of direct AI security experience.
 5+ years of experience implementing or supporting cybersecurity technologies in cloud, application, infrastructure, or security engineering environments
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Knowledge of implementing and supporting security controls in Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud environments
 Proficiency with securing Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, or related Microsoft technologies
 Familiarity with data loss prevention (DLP), cloud access security broker (CASB), security service edge (SSE), security information and event management (SIEM), endpoint detection and response (EDR), identity, and cloud-native security controls
 Capability to develop and automate solutions using Python, PowerShell, C#, Terraform, or comparable scripting and infrastructure-as-code technologies.
 Knowledge of integrating security controls into AI applications, APIs, data pipelines, development workflows, and AI-enabled systems
 Understanding of generative AI, machine learning platforms, large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI application architectures, and applicable AI security and governance frameworks, including NIST AI RMF, MITRE ATLAS, and ISO 42001
 Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Azure Security Engineer, Security+, Microsoft AI certifications, or equivalent credentials; familiarity with enterprise security technologies, monitoring, incident response, identity and access management, data protection, network security, and application security practices
 undefined
 
 Additional Information
 Must have unrestricted authorization to work in the USA. No visa sponsoring available
 
 Pay Range 
The annual salary for this position is between $117,500.00 - $234,500.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed. 
 Other Compensation 
This position is entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements. 
 Benefits 
 Employees are eligible for benefits, including:
 Health Care Benefits : Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives

 Retirement Benefits 

 Time off and Leave : Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation

 Disability : Short-term and long-term disability

 Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment 

 Tax-Advantaged Accounts: Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account

 Tuition Assistance 

 
 To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here Work with us | Carrier Corporate . The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.
 
 Carrier EEO Statement and Accommodations Process 
 Carrier is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status or any other applicable state or federal protected class. Carrier provides affirmative action in employment for qualified individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with section 503 of Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act. 
 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com . We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.
 
 Application Deadline 
Applications will be accepted for at least 3  days from Job Posting Date: 25 September 2026 
 Job Applicant's Privacy Notice 
 Please click on the link to review the Job Applicant Privacy Notice .
 
 Use of AI 
 Technology-enabled tools may support parts of the recruitment process, with oversight by people.
